tx90f.name: Days Above 90°F (TX90F)
tx90f.description: Number of days per year when the daily maximum temperature exceeds 90°F. Positive values indicate more hot days relative to the historical reference period (1981–2010).

heat.name: Heat Index Exceedance
heat.description: Number of days per year when the heat index exceeds dangerous thresholds relative to the historical baseline.

extreme_heat.name: Extreme Heat Days
extreme_heat.description: Number of days per year exceeding extreme heat thresholds relative to the historical baseline.

wbgt.name: Wet-Bulb Globe Temperature (WBGT)
wbgt.description: Change in wet-bulb globe temperature, a composite heat-stress metric accounting for temperature, humidity, wind, and solar radiation.

precip.name: Precipitation Change
precip.description: Change in annual or seasonal precipitation relative to the historical reference period (1981–2010). Positive = wetter.

wind.name: Wind Speed Change
wind.description: Change in mean wind speed relative to the historical reference period (1981–2010).
